effects.persistence: begins one hour after entry and increases each day

evidence.locator: When inside an enclosed structure, SCP-184 expands the structure's inner dimensions without altering its outer dimensions.

effects.trigger: original dimensions of the room have been tripled
constraints: The initial expansion has tripled the room's original dimensions.

evidence.locator: At this point, SCP-184 starts creating wholly new rooms.

effects.persistence: no additional structures are created after removal

evidence.locator: The changes do not go away with the removal of SCP-184, but no additional structures are created.

effects.persistence: until electromagnet power is restored after failure

evidence.locator: SCP-184 is to be attached to a high-power electromagnet at all times.
